main_text.p: formis mixtis, de quib. cum, quantū satis est, tra-ctauerimus, idcirco generalem, i. praecipuam & maximè necessariam systematis Politici partem nunc concludemus, & de speciali Politicæ prudentiæ parte vno post hac capite breuiter pertra-ctabimus.
main_text.head: POLITICI SYSTEMATIS
Pars specialis, vnico capite breuiter comprehensa.

p.i: Absoluimus diuino beneficio, generalem & potissimā systematis Politici partem; superest specialis, & minus præcipua, in qua agitur de statu Politico particulari, i. tali, qui particularibus & singularib. circumstantiis, certorū locorum, gentium ac temporum accommodatus, atque etiā propter illas singulares circumstantias à statu politico generali in nonnullis discrepat.

main_text.p: De statu politico particulari hi Canones notentur:

1 Sicut status Oeconomicus habet suas peculiares obseruationes, in particularib. locis, temporibus & personis: alia enim est œconomia hominis plebei, alia nobilis, alia regis, alia est œconomia ratio in Italia, in Germania, in Polonia: ita quoq; status Polit. habet suas singulares & particulares determinationes, pendentes à circūstantiis certorum populorum, locorum, temporum.
2 In distinctione ista status Politici generali & particularis fundata est distinctio iuris Polit. qd'nepe aliud ius sit commune, aliud particulare et municipale.

page.notes: The left-hand page is only partly visible as a cropped strip; its marginal fragments (e.g. "nsistit", "tos ad", "oterus", "facilè") are too cropped to transcribe reliably and are omitted. "qd'nepe" is printed as shown (likely quod nempe); the word "Absoluimus" is printed with a large A initial. Running head and number read from the scan; the page number 595 is set in a decorative figure and may be slightly uncertain.
